receipts.sharp_question: How do we prevent an adversarial gauntlet/audit from injecting false fixes when it was run on an incomplete source?

dewy_vector.D: Adopt ADR-061: no audit/gauntlet/skeptic flag is applied until re-verified by the operator against the FULL primary source (authoritative transcript + profiles + external-doc fetch); reject over-flags explicitly and log them; never blind-apply a prescribed fix; check quote provenance deterministically.
dewy_vector.E: The counterpart-gauntlet workflow, the dual-bar-raiser, the deterministic checker (provcheck.py), the operator.
dewy_vector.W: Standing discipline, effective immediately, generalizes to any promoted ADR/handoff/canon and the meta-audit.
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN — validated in the same session: caught 3 over-flags incl. the gauntlet's own #1 top-fix; one blind-apply would have replaced a truth with a new fabrication.

receipts.why: A gauntlet is only as honest as its source-of-truth. An abbreviated scratchpad transcript manufactured a top-ranked false 'fabrication' flag; deterministic re-verification against the re-pulled full transcript + profiles refuted it.
receipts.outcome: ADR-061 written + registered; falsification ledger established (_STATE/falsification-ledger.jsonl) recording both real defects and rejected over-flags.

receipts.sharp_question: Where do gauntlet/experiment results get logged so the flywheel has a test-and-falsify surface?

dewy_vector.D: Establish _STATE/falsification-ledger.jsonl (the gauntlet logbook named in the building-in-public flywheel memory) with a self-documenting schema; each entry records method, result, falsified[] AND over_flags_rejected[], the lesson, and cost.
dewy_vector.E: The building-in-public flywheel (lab->omakase->playground->experiment-ledger->codex/gauntlet/cellar), the gauntlet, the operator.
dewy_vector.W: Append-only, ongoing; first entry is the Kam codex gauntlet.
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN — created, first entry logged, on main (a4f42f8).

receipts.why: The memory named the ledger as design intent but no file existed; a falsification ledger's value is recording what got falsified on both sides (the artifact AND the test).
